name: Research Native Loop Template
description: CLI-only iterative research orchestration with Director, Researcher, and Evaluator.

inputs.task: Complete ultimate research goals with validated evidence and synthesis.
inputs.done_criteria: Research evidence closure with quality_score >= 0.95 and complete executive plus technical findings.
inputs.source_policy: Primary-source-first, but allow strong secondary signals when helpful.

quick_run.ai_action_on_trigger: When user says run research template or run research loop, run defaults using RESEARCH_GOALS.md, RESEARCH_PLAN.md, and FINDINGS.md.

required_behavior: Create run_dir if missing.
Create run-level isolated artifact folder under run_dir/runs/<run_id>.
Use active lock file to prevent concurrent runs.
Run bootstrap merge analysis before first research iteration.
Reuse completed prior work only after confidence-based verification.
Director preflight sets first research direction when role_mode=full.
Each iteration runs Researcher then Evaluator then Director post-note when role_mode=full.
In researcher_only mode, skip Director and Evaluator and run only Researcher each iteration.
In researcher_only mode, iteration 1 recovers memory then executes the next concrete step; iteration 2+ reviews previous iteration output then executes the next concrete step.
Maintain rolling-thread context continuity across iterations using bounded context packets.
In researcher_only mode, perform a scoped git commit per iteration when new iteration-local file deltas exist.
Evaluator can enforce adaptive compression checkpoints when context pressure rises.
For each researcher iteration, persist both machine-readable JSON and a human-readable markdown summary artifact.
When compression is enforced, write both context_snapshot.json and context_snapshot.md.
Director note is post-iteration only and compact/actionable by default.
Evaluator direction wins tie-break when evaluator and director differ.
Trigger Director full intervention on 25/50/75/100 progress milestones.
Trigger Director full intervention at quality_score >= 0.90 milestone.
Trigger Director full intervention on stall/risk-spike conditions.
Finalize only if director_approved_final=true and quality_score >= 0.95.
If blocked pattern appears, short-circuit and write blocker report.
Write lifecycle trace events to trace_log_file.

worker_prompt_template: You are the Researcher in an iterative CLI loop.
Return JSON then a short markdown summary.
reviewer_prompt_template: You are the Evaluator in an iterative CLI loop.
Evaluate researcher output for quality, progress, and risk.

Return strict JSON only with approved, quality_score, progress_pct, summary_for_user, next_direction, coverage, residual_risk, risk_level, enforce_compression, compression_reason, context_risk_score, snapshot_priority.
decision_rules: IF director_approved_final=true AND quality_score>=0.95 THEN finalize
ELSE IF evaluator_enforce_compression=true OR composite_context_trigger=true THEN write compression checkpoint
ELSE IF blocked_pattern_detected THEN stop and write blocker report
ELSE IF no_output_duration > max_idle_minutes THEN retry OR write blocker report
ELSE IF step failed AND retry_count < max_retries_per_step THEN retry with backoff
ELSE IF max_iterations > 0 AND iteration >= max_iterations THEN stop and mark residual risk

must_include: If blocked: reason + reproducible follow-up command
